name: IGF-1 LR3
subtitle: Long-arginine IGF-1 analogue
summary: Extended-half-life IGF-1 built for cell culture, adopted by bodybuilding. Potent, unforgiving, untested in humans.
caveat: Built for cell culture; no human studies, and hypoglycaemia is a real acute risk.
